KT_Forge integration
The basic DX12 RenderInterface adapter, GameUi facade, input filtering,
RenderGraph UI pass, sample RML/RCSS and procedural health.png were created
with Codex assistance at the user's request. The adapter was implemented
against the official interfaces; the upstream DX12 backend was not copied.
This notice does not determine the authorship or license of other engine code.
